Record Class TaskService.EquipmentCostLine

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
de.hallerweb.enterprise.prioritize.service.project.TaskService.EquipmentCostLine
Enclosing class:
TaskService
public static record TaskService.EquipmentCostLine(Long resourceId, String resourceName, long totalSeconds, int bookings, BigDecimal billedUnits, CostRateUnit unit, BigDecimal rate, String currency, BigDecimal amount, boolean running) extends Record
What one piece of equipment cost on a task: duration times rate, with every input it was computed from.

The parts are reported, not just the amount, because the rounding is a convention and conventions differ. A vertical that bills part days rather than started ones can recompute from totalSeconds instead of arguing with a number it cannot take apart — which is the same line CostRateUnit draws: the platform multiplies, it does not model tariffs.

billedUnits is the quantity actually charged in unit: fractional hours, whole started days, or the number of bookings for a per-use rate. amount is null when the resource keeps no rate — deliberately not 0, which would claim the device was free.

Author:
peter haller
